edits.new:
Then no run starts

  Scenario: AC12 A retried or timed-out activity does not duplicate the archive or delete a live record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a retention run activity is retried or times out
    When the retention run completes
    Then the archive holds one copy of each record
    Then no live record is deleted by the retried or timed-out activity

  Scenario: AC13 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the live record and ends the run FAILED (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call made by the retention run fails or does not answer
    When the retention run ends
    Then no live record is deleted
    Then the run ends FAILED
